**Logs (both, please)**
In `%APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers\` (paste that into Explorer's address bar):
- `SpaceEngineersVR.log`: the last run
- `SpaceEngineersVR.prev.log`: the run before it. Starting the game again moves the log here, so if you restarted
  after the problem, this is the one that has it.

Drag both files into this box to attach them. If the game crashed, the game's own log from the same folder
(`SpaceEngineers_*.log`, the newest) helps too.

**Anything else**
Screenshots, a short video, the world (creative or survival, planet or space), single player or multiplayer, other
plugins or mods you run.
